detail: One row per patient is required.
Response must use the controlled vocabulary.
Diagnosis must precede every treatment start.
Treatment start must not follow end.
All diagnoses patient keys must resolve.
All treatment_events patient keys must resolve.
All outcomes patient keys must resolve.
All comorbidities patient keys must resolve.
All utilization patient keys must resolve.
Utilization and costs cannot be negative.
Treatment lines must begin at one and be contiguous per patient.
